svg.title: Docent dense classifier run
svg.desc: Training and validation loss every five epochs, held-out intent and destination accuracy, the validation confusion matrix over destinations, and three decoded queries: an authored one, an ambiguous one, and an unsupported one.
svg.text: DENSE DOCENT RUN -- loss, accuracy, confusion, decoded queries
0 .. 1; the usefulness bar is 0.9 for both
validation confusion by destination (rows true, cols predicted)
"what is this campus" -> explain / campus (1), then none (0) [true: explain / campus]
"show me an old computer" -> navigate / ibm-1130-emulator (1), then computer-history (0) [true: recommend / ibm-1130-emulator]
"write me a sorting algorithm" -> unsupported / none (1), then moe-microscope (0) [true: unsupported / none]
HOW: u:docent_eval decodes every row with argmax on both heads and argtop_k; numbers are in docent-results.md.
